newsitem.title: UK: UK minister hopes to reduce regulation burden.
newsitem.headline: UK minister hopes to reduce regulation burden.

text.p: UK Treasury minister Angela Knight said the government wanted to reduce the burdens of regulation and administration in the financial services sector while maintaining high standards of investor protection. "In order to maintain and improve the competitiveness of the industry the government must do all it can to reduce the burdens of regulation and administration whilst maintaining high standards and investor protection," Knight said on Wednesday. She was speaking at a financial deregulation seminar designed to encourage participation by practitioners in any changes that are made.
Knight told a news briefing the issue of Morgan Grenfell Asset Management had not been raised, but she said it looked like an isolated incident that should not have a knock-on effect on the industry.
Once investigations were complete, changes would be made if they were needed, but she felt these would be minor.

Knight defended the Financial Services Act, saying that any change would be "disruptive, divisive and expensive." She added that proposals for simplifying the system were already being looked at. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
